name: GLM-5.3-Flash EXL3（TP=2 · DFlash2 · 1M）
description: GLM-5.3-Flash（320B/A18B MoE，glm5_next）双节点 TP=2 服务——EXL3/TR3 路线：Mia-AiLab uniform-K4 4bpw 权重镜像（brandonmusic 快照，~164GiB/120 分片）+ fp8 KV（packed fp8_ds_mla）+ DFlash2 k=7 投机，EXL3_FAT_KERNEL=1（E2 fat-expert prefill 内核）+ MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS 7168（上游 2026-09-01 E2 默认），1M 上下文（padded slot-share）；Vision 默认开启（image×4 / video×1）。实测 decode：单流 62.9 tok/s（×2 聚合 103.3 / ×4 聚合 146.5）。
compose_template:
services:
  vllm-glm53-exl3:
    image: ${GLM53EXL3_IMAGE:-registry.cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/aixn-public/glm53-flash-exl3:v1.1.0}
    container_name: ${TASK_NAME}-rank${NODE_RANK}
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "python3", "-c", "import urllib.request,sys; sys.exit(0 if urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:${VLLM_PORT:-8888}/health', timeout=5).status == 200 else 1)"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 900s
    pull_policy: if_not_present  # 节点不支持 pull，镜像由集群镜像仓库分发到各节点；本地已有即用
    entrypoint: []
    network_mode: host
    ipc: host
    shm_size: "32gb"
    cap_add:
      - IPC_LOCK
    ulimits:
      memlock: -1
      stack: 67108864
      nofile: 1048576
    gpus: all
    devices:
      - /dev/infiniband:/dev/infiniband
    volumes:
      # 生产 launcher 把主模型 + DFlash2 草稿都放在 /root/.cache/huggingface（HF_HOME 指向它，按 HF repo id 离线解析）
      - ${HF_CACHE:-${HOME}/.cache/huggingface}:/root/.cache/huggingface
      # CUDA graph / JIT 编译缓存挂持久卷，容器重建不丢
      - ${GLM53EXL3_CACHE:-${HOME}/.cache/vllm-glm53-exl3}:/root/.cache/vllm
      # Triton / TileLang JIT 缓存：overlay 内核编译慢，随持久卷保存（源 launcher 也挂这两个）
      - ${GLM53EXL3_CACHE:-${HOME}/.cache/vllm-glm53-exl3}/triton:/root/.triton/cache
      - ${GLM53EXL3_CACHE:-${HOME}/.cache/vllm-glm53-exl3}/tilelang:/root/.tilelang/cache
    environment:
      HF_HOME: /root/.cache/huggingface
      HF_HUB_OFFLINE: "1"  # 模型由管理平台分发到节点缓存，固定离线加载
      HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET: "${HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET:-1}"
      TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE: "1"
      VLLM_CACHE_ROOT: /root/.cache/vllm
      VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S: "3600"
      VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: "${VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-1800}"  # 上源 1800（冷启动 JIT 超时长）
      TRITON_CACHE_DIR: "/root/.triton/cache"
      TILELANG_CACHE_DIR: "/root/.tilelang/cache"
      VLLM_NO_USAGE_STATS: "1"  # py-cpuinfo/aarch64 usage 线程 JSONDecodeError；源 launcher 关统计
      DO_NOT_TRACK: "1"
      LANGUAGE_MODEL_ONLY: "${LANGUAGE_MODEL_ONLY:-0}"
      LIMIT_MM: "${LIMIT_MM:-}"
      # 上游 overlay 行为开关（哨兵执行，缺文件自动跳过）
      # 镜像侧记录：ACR 按上游现行 Dockerfile 烘焙（@c707598，2026-09-01）；suppress_stops/scheduler_decode_floor/hybrid_prefix_hit/xgrammar/kpool/spinwait/indexer-workspace 补丁已全部入镜像并通过构建自检，exl3_fat_gemm（E2 内核）构建期编译入 exllamav3_ext
      EXL3_FUSED_MOE: "${EXL3_FUSED_MOE:-1}"
      EXL3_FAT_KERNEL: "${EXL3_FAT_KERNEL:-1}"  # 1 = E2 fat-expert prefill 内核（v1.1.0 镜像已编译，上游 2026-09-01 默认）；0 = 旧胖 expert 路径（无需重建镜像）
      GLM53_SPINWAIT_MS: "${GLM53_SPINWAIT_MS:-stock}"  # stock = vLLM 默认 1s 自旋；数字 = 毫秒（上游数值化自旋补丁）
      GLM53_INDEXER_WORKSPACE: "${GLM53_INDEXER_WORKSPACE:-rightsize}"  # rightsize（默认，1M 下把锁死的 ~5 GiB indexer workspace 缩到按需）；stock = 上游现行默认
      # o_proj 正交化（上游 start.sh 同款，patch_ablit.py 每次启动应用，ABLIT=0 时纯 stock 权重）
      ABLIT: "${ABLIT:-0}"
      ABLIT_METHOD: "${ABLIT_METHOD:-auto}"  # auto | transplant | proj
      ABLIT_DIRECTION: "${ABLIT_DIRECTION:-dealign}"  # dealign | bf_oproj | /path/dir.pt
      ABLIT_LAYERS: "${ABLIT_LAYERS:-15-45}"  # 含 45 = checkpoint MTP block
      ABLIT_ALPHA: "${ABLIT_ALPHA:-3.0}"
      ABLIT_INCLUDE_MTP: "${ABLIT_INCLUDE_MTP:-1}"
      VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS: "${VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS:-1}"  # 保持 vLLM 默认：CUDA-graph 显存估计是图捕获的物理预留，设 0 会图捕获超额被系统 OOM 杀（实测）
      GLM53_MIXED_PREFILL_CHUNK: "${GLM53_MIXED_PREFILL_CHUNK:-skip}"
      GLM53_SUPPRESS_STOPS_IN_REASONING: "${GLM53_SUPPRESS_STOPS_IN_REASONING:-1}"
      # SM121 架构 + fp8_ds_mla KV 所需（源 launcher 全部保留）
      TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "12.1a"
      FLASHINFER_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "12.1a"
      FLASHINFER_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK: "1"
      PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF: expandable_segments:True
      VLLM_HOST_IP: "${VLLM_HOST_IP:-}"
      # 网络：RoCE（CX7 直连），HCA 由 hca 自动键逗号分隔填充；GID 每启动动态解析
      NCCL_NET: "${NCCL_NET:-IB}"
      NCCL_NET_PLUGIN: none
      NCCL_IB_DISABLE: "0"
      NCCL_IB_HCA: "${NCCL_IB_HCA:-}"
      NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX: "${NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX:-}"
      NCCL_IB_GID_AUTO: "1"
      NCCL_IB_ADDR_FAMILY: AF_INET
      NCCL_IB_ROCE_VERSION_NUM: 2
      NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME: "${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME:-}"
      GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME: "${GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME:-${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME}}"
      NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE: "0"
      NCCL_CROSS_NIC: "0"
      NCCL_IB_MERGE_NICS: "0"
      NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE: "0"
      NCCL_IGNORE_CPU_AFFINITY: "1"
      NCCL_DEBUG: WARN
      TORCH_NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING: "1"
    command:
      - bash
      - -lc
      - >
        set -e;
        if [ -f /opt/glm53/patch_glm_video_placeholders.py ]; then python3 /opt/glm53/patch_glm_video_placeholders.py; fi;
        if [ -f /opt/glm53/patch_suppress_stops_in_reasoning.py ]; then python3 /opt/glm53/patch_suppress_stops_in_reasoning.py; fi;
        if [ -f /opt/glm53/patch_scheduler_decode_floor.py ]; then python3 /opt/glm53/patch_scheduler_decode_floor.py; fi;
        if [ -f /opt/glm53/patch_glm5_drafter_group.py ]; then python3 /opt/glm53/patch_glm5_drafter_group.py; fi;
        if [ -f /opt/glm53/patch_hybrid_prefix_hit.py ]; then python3 /opt/glm53/patch_hybrid_prefix_hit.py; fi;
        if [ -f /opt/glm53/patch_xgrammar_termination.py ]; then python3 /opt/glm53/patch_xgrammar_termination.py; fi;
        if [ -f /opt/glm53/patch_kpool_tail_slotmap.py ]; then python3 /opt/glm53/patch_kpool_tail_slotmap.py; fi;
        if [ -f /opt/glm53/patch_spinwait.py ]; then python3 /opt/glm53/patch_spinwait.py; fi;
        if [ -f /opt/glm53/patch_indexer_workspace.py ]; then python3 /opt/glm53/patch_indexer_workspace.py; fi;
        if [ -f /opt/glm53/patch_ablit.py ]; then python3 /opt/glm53/patch_ablit.py; fi;
        if [ "$${LANGUAGE_MODEL_ONLY:-0}" = "1" ]; then
          MM_ARGS="--language-model-only";
        else
          if [ -z "$${LIMIT_MM:-}" ]; then LIMIT_MM='{"image":4,"video":1}'; fi;
          MM_ARGS="--limit-mm-per-prompt $${LIMIT_MM} --skip-mm-profiling";
        fi;
        exec /usr/local/bin/vllm serve ${GLM53EXL3_MODEL_PATH:-Mia-AiLab/GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3-TR3-4bpw}
        --served-model-name ${SERVED_MODEL_NAME:-GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3}
        --host 0.0.0.0
        --port ${VLLM_PORT:-8888}
        --tensor-parallel-size 2
        --gpu-memory-utilization ${GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION:-0.87}
        --max-model-len ${MAX_MODEL_LEN:-1000000}
        --max-num-seqs ${MAX_NUM_SEQS:-4}
        --max-num-batched-tokens ${MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS:-7168}
        --quantization exl3
        --kv-cache-dtype ${KV_CACHE_DTYPE:-fp8}
        --enable-prefix-caching
        --enable-prompt-tokens-details
        --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune
        --tool-call-parser glm47
        --enable-auto-tool-choice
        --reasoning-parser glm45
        --speculative-config '{"method":"dflash","model":"${GLM53EXL3_DRAFT_PATH:-incoai/GLM-5.3-Flash-DFlash2}","num_speculative_tokens":${GLM53EXL3_DFLASH_TOKENS:-7},"kv_cache_dtype":"auto","draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","rejection_sample_method":"standard","draft_tensor_parallel_size":${GLM53EXL3_DFLASH_DRAFT_TP:-2}}'
        --cudagraph-capture-sizes 1 2 4 8 16 24 32
        --chat-template ${CHAT_TEMPLATE:-/opt/glm53/chat_template.jinja}
        $${MM_ARGS}
        --distributed-executor-backend mp
        --nnodes ${NODES_TOTAL:-2}
        --node-rank ${NODE_RANK}
        --master-addr ${MASTER_ADDR}
        --master-port ${MASTER_PORT:-29521}
        ${HEADLESS:+--headless}

variables.label: vLLM 镜像
variables.help: ACR 烘焙 EXL3 overlay 镜像（按上游 MiaAI-Lab Dockerfile @c707598；运行时补丁全部入镜像）
variables.help_en: ACR-baked EXL3 overlay image (from the upstream MiaAI-Lab Dockerfile @c707598; all runtime patches baked in)

variables.label: 模型
variables.help: EXL3/TR3 uniform-K4 4bpw 主模型（默认 Mia-AiLab 镜像；勿换 NVFP4 权重）
variables.help_en: EXL3/TR3 uniform-K4 4bpw main model (default Mia-AiLab mirror; do not swap in NVFP4 weights)

variables.label: DFlash2 Drafter 模型
variables.help: DFlash2 块扩散草稿模型（~2.3 GiB；与主模型一样分发到节点缓存）
variables.help_en: DFlash2 block-diffusion draft model (~2.3 GiB; distribute to the node cache like the main model)

variables.label: 最大上下文长度
variables.help: 上游生产档 1,000,000（util 0.87 下池 1,754,237 token / 1.75×）；勿为省 KV 降到 256k
variables.help_en: Upstream production 1,000,000 (pool 1,754,237 tokens / 1.75× at util 0.87); do not drop to 256k

variables.label: 最大并发序列数
variables.help: 上游生产 4（decode 批）；投机每序列额外 k+1 token
variables.help_en: Upstream production 4 (decode batch); speculation adds k+1 tokens per sequence

variables.label: 单批最大 token 数
variables.help: 上游 E2 默认 7168（配合 EXL3_FAT_KERNEL=1）；8192 撑爆 GB10 indexer smem，勿用
variables.help_en: Upstream E2 default 7168 (with EXL3_FAT_KERNEL=1); 8192 blows the GB10 indexer smem — never

variables.label: 融合 EXL3 MoE
variables.help: 1 = 每层融合 exl3_moe（默认，快）；0 = 逐 expert 循环（慢）
variables.help_en: 1 = fused exl3_moe per layer (default, faster); 0 = per-expert loop (slower)

variables.label: E2 fat-expert prefill 内核
variables.help: 1（默认）= 走构建期编译的 exl3_fat_gemm E2 内核（MNBT=7168 的前提）；0 = 回退旧胖 expert 路径
variables.help_en: 1 (default) = use the build-time-compiled exl3_fat_gemm E2 kernel (premise for MNBT=7168); 0 = legacy fat-expert path

variables.label: 解码自旋等待毫秒数
variables.help: stock = vLLM 默认 1s 自旋；数字 = 自旋毫秒（16ms 档实测单流略快）；0 = 关
variables.help_en: stock = vLLM default 1 s spin; a number = spin-wait ms (16 ms measured slightly faster single-stream); 0 = off

variables.label: Sparse-indexer workspace
variables.help: rightsize（默认）= workspace 按需预留，1M 下把锁死的 ~5 GiB 还回 KV；stock = 上游默认（锁 ~5 GiB）
variables.help_en: rightsize (default) = size the workspace per step, returning ~5 GiB to KV at 1M; stock = upstream default (locks ~5 GiB)

variables.label: o_proj 正交化（abliteration）
variables.help: 1 = 加载时对 o_proj 正交化（dealign，15-45 层）；未压测勿开
variables.help_en: 1 = orthogonalize o_proj at load (dealign, layers 15-45); enable only after benching

variables.label: 混合 prefill 策略
variables.help: decode 步不混入 peer prefill（混合会把 decode 压到 ~5 tok/s）；skip = 跳过本步；N>0 = 上限 N token
variables.help_en: Do not mix peer prefill into decode steps (mixing stalls decode at ~5 tok/s); skip = defer; N>0 = cap at N tokens

variables.label: thinking 内抑制 stop
variables.help: 1（默认）= thinking 结束前客户端 stop 保持休眠；0 = 关
variables.help_en: 1 (default) = keep client stops dormant until </thinking>; 0 = off

variables.label: CUDA graph 显存预留估算
variables.help: 保持 1（默认）：扣 CUDA-graph 显存估计（图捕获的物理预留，设 0 会被系统 OOM 杀）
variables.help_en: Keep 1 (default): deducts the CUDA-graph reserve; 0 lets capture exceed memory and the system OOM-kills the process

variables.label: GPU 显存利用率
variables.help: 上游实测 0.87（池 ~18.67 GiB）；本机 KV <14.61 GiB 时先核对镜像再调 ≥0.90；过高失去 MM/长 prefill 余量
variables.help_en: Upstream-validated 0.87 (pool ~18.67 GiB); if KV < 14.61 GiB verify the image then raise to ≥0.90; too high loses MM/long-prefill headroom

variables.label: KV 缓存类型
variables.help: 上游要求 fp8（packed fp8_ds_mla）；bf16/nvfp4 都别用
variables.help_en: Upstream requires fp8 (packed fp8_ds_mla); do not use bf16/nvfp4

variables.label: DFlash2 投机 token 数
variables.help: 必须是 7（trained block 8）：上游 k=7 档位
variables.help_en: Must be 7 (trained block 8): the upstream k=7 tier

variables.label: Drafter TP（1 = rank0 独占）
variables.help: 2（默认）= drafter 跨 TP 分片（投机不过 CX7，structured 65.1 tok/s）；1 = 草稿只留 rank 0
variables.help_en: 2 (default) = shard the drafter across TP (structured 65.1 tok/s); 1 = keep the draft on rank 0

variables.label: 仅文本（不加载视觉塔）
variables.help: 0（默认）= 加载视觉塔；1 = 仅文本（更快）
variables.help_en: 0 (default) = load the vision tower; 1 = text-only (faster)

variables.label: 跳过 MM dummy profile
variables.help: 保持 1（最大规格 MM dummy profile 会 OOM）
variables.help_en: Keep 1 (a max-size MM dummy profile OOMs this UMA)

variables.label: 每请求多模态上限
variables.help: --limit-mm-per-prompt 的 JSON（默认 {"image":4,"video":1}；清空则回退该默认）
variables.help_en: JSON for --limit-mm-per-prompt (default {"image":4,"video":1}; clearing it falls back to the default)

variables.label: Chat 模板路径
variables.help: 镜像内 MM 模板（默认）；checkpoint 自带的是纯文本版
variables.help_en: In-image MM template (default); the checkpoint's built-in one is language-only

variables.label: Head 节点地址
variables.help: 自动填充 head 节点的 RoCE IP（多节点协调地址，随任务的 head 变化）
variables.help_en: Filled with the head node's RoCE IP (multi-node coordination address, follows per-task head)

variables.label: 节点总数
variables.help: 由任务节点数自动填充（本配方为固定 2 节点拓扑，发布时校验恰好匹配）
variables.help_en: Auto-filled from task node count (fixed 2-node topology; publish validates exact match)

variables.label: Headless（worker 不跑 API server）
variables.help: 自动按角色填充：head 为空、worker 为 1（mp 多节点协调必需）
variables.help_en: Auto-filled per role: empty on head, 1 on workers (required for mp multi-node coordination)

variables.label: 本节点 vLLM 绑定 IP
variables.help: 必须为各节点 RoCE IP，避免分布式绑定错误地址
variables.help_en: Must be each node's RoCE IP to avoid binding the wrong address

variables.label: RoCE HCA
variables.help: hca 自动键按节点返回逗号分隔多 rail（源单 rail：rocep1s0f1 / rocep1s0f0）
variables.help_en: The hca auto key returns comma-separated rails per node (upstream single-rail: rocep1s0f1 / rocep1s0f0)

variables.label: NCCL 网络接口
variables.help: auto 返回首选 RoCE 口（源：enp1s0f1np1 ↔ enp1s0f0np0）；多 rail 场景可手工覆盖
variables.help_en: auto returns the preferred RoCE interface (upstream: enp1s0f1np1 ↔ enp1s0f0np0); override for multi-rail

variables.label: RoCE GID index
variables.help: 每节点/HCA 不同且重启漂移，自动解析（源 launcher 硬编码 3）
variables.help_en: Per-node/per-HCA and drifts across reboots; auto-resolved (upstream hard-codes 3)

description_en: 2-node TP=2 serving for GLM-5.3-Flash (320B/A18B MoE, glm5_next) on the EXL3/TR3 lane: Mia-AiLab uniform-K4 4bpw weight mirror (brandonmusic snapshot, ~164 GiB / 120 shards) + fp8 KV (packed fp8_ds_mla) + DFlash2 k=7 speculation, EXL3_FAT_KERNEL=1 (E2 fat-expert prefill kernel) with max-num-batched-tokens 7168 (upstream 2026-09-01 E2 default), 1M context (padded slot-share); Vision on by default (image×4 / video×1). Measured decode: 62.9 tok/s single-stream (2-way aggregate 103.3 / 4-way aggregate 146.5).
